title: Japan Liquidity Enhancement Auction, remaining maturities 1–5 years (¥700bn announced) — the out-of-sample zone that refutes the family's coupon ordering, printing 15 days before the 5-11y auction
source: EST: mof.go.jp English September 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2609e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,795 bytes) by the jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-09-25 initial research; its table row reads 'Sep. 10, 2026 | Liquidity Enhancement Auction (remaining maturities of 1-5 years)'. UNLIKE ITS 5-11y SIBLING, THIS ONE'S TERMS ARE ALREADY PUBLISHED: MOF's own announcement auct20260903e.htm, dated September 3, 2026 and fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200), names Auction Date September 10, 2026, Issue Date September 11, 2026, Offering Amount 'About 700 billion yen', and eligible issues 2-Year No.476-488, 5-Year No.154-185, 10-Year No.348-363, 20-Year No.97-129 and 30-Year No.1-5. Cadence re-verified from MOF's own 35 consecutive monthly calendars 2401e → 2611e (all HTTP 200): this zone appears in 18 of the 35 months, every odd month without exception, 2024-01-05 through 2026-11-20. Filed `estimate` on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office — the date, the size and the issue list are all MOF primary and none is in doubt
notes: Discovered 2026-09-09 during the jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-09-25 initial-research adjacency sweep, on MOF's own September calendar. IT IS NOT CALENDAR PADDING AND IT IS NOT PROPOSED FOR COMPLETENESS — this zone is the out-of-sample evidence the 5-11y research is built on. The jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-10-22 ledger explicitly declined to propose it ('the coupon ordering predicts it should show the same monotonicity; that is an untested prediction'). It has now been tested: all 16 completed prints 2024-01-05 → 2026-07-16 were parsed from MOF's own result and 'Issues Re-opened' pages, and THE ORDERING DOES NOT REPLICATE. At auction-clustered 95% intervals the LOWEST-coupon security in the zone (10-year, 0.100% weighted-average coupon) is OVERWEIGHT at 1.07x (0.77-1.36) while the HIGHEST (30-year, 2.507%) is UNDERWEIGHT at 0.61x (0.00-1.81), and 5-year paper (0.713%) is the most underweight security in the zone at 0.49x (0.24-0.82); only 20-year (2.056%) is strongly overweight at 2.12x (1.63-2.71). The zone's aggregate coupon-weighted overweight IS positive (+0.296pp, CI +0.149 to +0.455, 15 of 16 prints), but at the issue level that signal is fully absorbed by REMAINING MATURITY (+0.672, CI +0.186 to +1.136) with coupon collapsing to +0.228 and its interval spanning zero. MOF ALSO RAISED THIS ZONE TWICE while cutting the super-long: ¥500bn for the first ten prints, ¥600bn on 2025-09-08, ¥700bn from 2025-11-21 onward — so the reallocation toward the short end is larger than the 5-11y record alone shows. The 2026-09-10 print is the 17th, and it lands 15 days before jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-09-25, which makes it the leading read on that auction and the scoring instrument for FT-jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-09-25-4. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. Because it prints the day after this proposal was written, expect it to reach the scanner as a close-out rather than a forward assessment — that is the intended use, not a defect. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
